title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian shares the happy news of Suganaya's bangle ceremony with the family. However, Saravanan sparks tension by refusing to eat the dinner prepared by Thangamayil.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Following traditional wedding rituals, Cheran and Chandhayatha rejoice as Pallavan sets off crackers. Later, Thenmozhi rebukes Nila for taking on all the household chores.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sinthamani's false claim about Muthu's travel company sparks conflict at Sathya's reception. Vijaya fiercely defends Muthu, refusing to let anyone speak ill of him.

title: Neeya Naana
description: A fascinating debate explores hereditary dances from epics with lively performances by dance artists. Watch a surprising review reveal the ancient origins of these dance forms!

title: Super Singer Junior
episodeTitle: A Soulful Tribute to Deva's Music
description: Judges are spellbound as Little Stars deliver energetic renditions of Deva's hits. Tears of joy follow as Deva's musical troupe surprises him with a pleasant entry on stage.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
episodeTitle: Fun and Games with the Comalis
description: Kureishi hosts an entertaining guessing challenge as teams compete in movie and clue rounds. Contestants make strategic ATM choices and earn points as they battle for the top spot.
